raw.buffDescription: Every 12 seconds, the Attacker gets Passively [k=glossary/root]Rooted[/k] for 5 seconds. If the Attacker is far away from the Defender when this triggers, the Defender gets Passively Rooted instead. The timer will only restart after the Root has expired and it is paused during Specials.
